item.title: nginx-1.30.6 stable and nginx-1.31.7 mainline versions have been released, with fixes for buffer overflow vulnerability when using alias with rewrite (CVE-2026-15176), buffer overflow vulnerability when evaluating string expressions with variables (CVE-2026-93479), request body injection vulnerability in HTTP/3 (CVE-2026-95101), session forgery vulnerability when using TLS session ticket key rotation (CVE-2026-97629), and use-after-free vulnerability when using ngx_http_ssi_module with AIO (CVE-2026-97205).
item.description:
2026-10-14

nginx-1.30.6 stable and nginx-1.31.7 mainline versions have been released, with fixes for buffer overflow vulnerability when using alias with rewrite (CVE-2026-15176), buffer overflow vulnerability when evaluating string expressions with variables (CVE-2026-93479), request body injection vulnerability in HTTP/3 (CVE-2026-95101), session forgery vulnerability when using TLS session ticket key rotation (CVE-2026-97629), and use-after-free vulnerability when using ngx_http_ssi_module with AIO (CVE-2026-97205).
